raw.title: v0.1.2
raw.body:
## Critical Bug Fixes

- **Runtime errors now route through onFailure handlers** — HTTP timeouts, connection failures, and response-too-large errors previously bypassed `onFailure` entirely. They now flow through the action dispatch, enabling retry and goto actions for network failures. This is a spec compliance fix.
- **Original error kinds preserved** — when a step fails and `onFailure: end` fires, the error now reflects the root cause (e.g. `RUNTIME_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE`) instead of being masked as `RUNTIME_SUCCESS_CRITERIA_FAILED`.
- **`step_result_error` preserves error context** — the fallback error path (no matching action) now uses the original error kind from the step result.

## Bug Fixes (from v0.1.1)

- NOT operator precedence, bracket key access, escaped quotes, array query params, cookie encoding, goto interpolation, complex parameter values — all included in this release.

## Stats

- 363 tests passing

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strefethen/arazzo-cli/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
